max.$description: Maximum viewport width of the lg breakpoint. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.lg.min.

min.$description: Minimum viewport width at which the lg breakpoint applies. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.lg.max.

view.$description: Reference design viewport width for lg layouts.

max.$description: Maximum viewport width of the md breakpoint. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.md.min.

min.$description: Minimum viewport width at which the md breakpoint applies. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.md.max.

view.$description: Reference design viewport width for md layouts.

max.$description: Maximum viewport width of the sm breakpoint. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.sm.min.

min.$description: Minimum viewport width at which the sm breakpoint applies. Pairs with brand.breakpoint.sm.max.

view.$description: Reference design viewport width for sm layouts.

margin.$description: Page grid side margin at the lg breakpoint.
Page grid side margin at the md breakpoint.
Page grid side margin at the sm breakpoint.

control.$description: Base unit for independently sizing controls. Control heights, horizontal padding and gaps derive from this value; spacing and radius scales are unaffected.

ui.$description: Base UI unit. Every spacing step and radius primitive multiplies it.
